fields.label: Provide the experimental design/protocol/animal model
fields.help:
Provide a description of the design and protocol, including:
- What animal model will be used for the study
- Experimental unit (e.g., individual animal, cage, litter, ten molars of one dog)
- Strategy to minimize potential confounders (e.g., order of treatments and measurements, animal/cage location). If there is none, please state so.
- Housing conditions and acclimatisation period(s).

fields.label: Supporting image (optional)
fields.help:
You may upload one image to support this item. Relevant images could be:
- An experimental timeline/flowchart, e.g. showing acclimatisation period, treatment order, measurements/assessment time points, end of study.
- Cage or rack layout diagram, e.g. showing planned spatial distribution of groups/cages, to support your confounder control strategy.
- Randomisation or allocation diagram, e.g. showing how animals (or cages/litters) will be assigned to groups.
If more than one visual would help, use item 25 for the rest.
Accepted formats: JPG, PNG or GIF. Maximum file size: 2 MB per image.

fields.label: Justify number of animals/Sample size calculation
fields.help: Please indicate if a sample size calculation was performed in advance and if so, please specify the sample size calculation. This typically includes alpha, beta, minimal detectable difference and expected number of drop-outs (due to mortality or other causes).

fields.label: Details?
fields.help:
If yes: Please specify the sample size calculation
If no: Please explain why a sample size calculation was not performed

fields.label: Supporting image (optional)
fields.help:
You may upload one image to support this item. Relevant images could be:
- Screenshot of your power calculation, e.g. G-Power screenshot.
Accepted formats: JPG, PNG or GIF. Maximum file size: 2 MB per image.

fields.label: Sum of animals

fields.label: Study arms/groups
fields.help:
Please indicate all of the study arms/groups and their purpose
In the number column please indicate the number of animals per arm or group. Make sure that the sum of all groups together is equal to the total number given in item 19.
To note: if you register several experiments in this protocol, please specify in the text box intervention 'exp 1', 'exp2' followed by the name of the intervention, e.g. 'exp 1 - placebo control'

fields.label: Additional information
fields.help:
Please give any other information about the study that is not covered elsewhere in the Form, such as:
- inclusion/exclusion criteria used for animals or experimental units during the experiments and/or for data points during analysis
- Statistical plan (e.g., tests planned, software(s) you will use)
- How to assess whether the data met the assumptions of the statistical approach.
- The strategy used for refinement

fields.label: Supporting images (optional)
fields.help:
You may upload up to three images to support this item or other items without an image upload function. Relevant images could be:
- An image of your ethical score sheet or humane endpoint table. If it is too large, you may upload it via 2 pictures.
Accepted formats: JPG, PNG or GIF. Maximum file size: 2 MB per image.

fields.label: Link to data
fields.help:
Please provide links to any related published articles, or data provided in any data repository (e.g. Dataverse, Open Science Framework, Figshare, Zenodo)
(!) At the end of your study, we highly encourage you to submit any unpublished results to the FC3R Short Note platform – a peer-review platform disseminating unpublished data. This allows your data to remain available and reduce unnecessary duplication and publication bias while gaining as much recognition as a published peer-reviewed paper.
